s0: Gilded rims: every panel gets a thin inner gold line, the top bar and tabs turn to brushed metal with a gold seam, and panel headers fade from gold into the panel.

Foil titles and jewel tabs: the title tab gets a foil sheen, a gold underline and a glowing gold gem; the open tab wears a gem and throws a beam of light up into the scene; top-bar numbers glow in their own colour.
Living buttons: the big gold buttons get a glass gloss, a light sweep and a slow golden breathing glow; the picked choice card shimmers; gold small buttons shimmer too.
Atmosphere: a soft coloured haze in the screen's own key light hangs over the scene, slanted light shafts fall from above, and dust motes drift up through it.

Dressed text boxes: text boxes get a pearl gradient, gold corner filigree and a faint gold halo; name plates get a gold diamond and a ribbon tail; speech bubbles get a soft gradient; the ▼ next arrow bobs.
Rim light: every character and Pokémon gets a violet rim light on one edge and a soft glow, so they pop off the background.
Depth of field: out-of-focus bokeh lights in the screen's two colours float at the edges, giving the scene a camera-lens depth.
Hero numbers: the big numbers (dials, nets, top-bar values) become chunky stacked 3D numerals with a glow in their own colour.
Signature particles: its own particles: shooting stars, twinkling stars.
Colour grade: a film-style colour grade washes the whole screen (key light from the top left, accent from the bottom right), and the dark vignette turns a deep Nova violet.
Entrance: when the screen opens, its panels, cards and buttons rise and fade in one after another with a small overshoot, so every screen arrives like a show (rest frame unchanged).
Orbiting halo: whatever is picked (the chosen card, tile, district or rank) gets a bright spark that runs round and round its border.
Liquid meters: every meter fills with moving candy stripes and a bright cap at its edge; dials get a ring of tick marks; the lean slider knob glows.
Icon medallions: each panel header's icon sits in a round gold-rimmed medallion with a soft glow, like a badge.
Holographic foil: the most important cards (gold panels, your Goal, Family squads, the picked tile) get a slow holographic foil sweep across them.
Nova damask: panels get a faint woven pattern of Team Nova N marks and little gold diamonds, like the lining of a Boss's coat.
Focal spotlight: a breathing pool of light sits behind the DOMINION logo, the one thing the eye should land on first.
Light show: a neon glow breathes around the edge of the screen, and two searchlights in the screen's colours sweep the night sky behind everything.
Gold-leaf lettering: title-tab lettering gets a bevel (light top edge, deep shadow), headers on gold panels turn to gold leaf, and ribbons and banners get engraved edges.
Ornate frame: the whole screen gets a fine double gold frame with filigree corners and gem studs, so every screen reads as a framed Dominion page.
Depth and underglow: panels float higher: a deeper soft shadow plus an underglow in the screen's key colour, so the UI layer separates cleanly from the scene behind it.
Hardware details: tabs get brass screw heads, pills and chips get a glossy top, paper notes get a stitched inner seam, and key caps get a shiny bevel.

Readability and naming check: checked that every line still reads clearly over the new effects: haze, bokeh and particles sit behind the panels, and the grade and edge glow are too soft to cut contrast. Small muted text gets a dark halo.
Living backdrop: the background never sits still: painted scenes slowly drift and zoom like a camera pan, and checkered floors slide gently.
Finale burst: a slow-turning sunburst crowns the DOMINION logo and two star glints flash beside it: the screen's signature moment.

Atmosphere: a soft coloured haze in the screen's own key light hangs over the scene, slanted light shafts fall from above, and dust motes drift up through it.

Dressed text boxes: text boxes get a pearl gradient, gold corner filigree and a faint gold halo; name plates get a gold diamond and a ribbon tail; speech bubbles get a soft gradient; the ▼ next arrow bobs.
Rim light: every character and Pokémon gets a warm amber rim light on one edge and a soft glow, so they pop off the background.
Depth of field: out-of-focus bokeh lights in the screen's two colours float at the edges, giving the scene a camera-lens depth.
Hero numbers: the big numbers (dials, nets, top-bar values) become chunky stacked 3D numerals with a glow in their own colour.
Signature particles: its own particles: music notes (Mick sang).
Colour grade: a film-style colour grade washes the whole screen (key light from the top left, accent from the bottom right), and the dark vignette turns a deep Nova violet.
Entrance: when the screen opens, its panels, cards and buttons rise and fade in one after another with a small overshoot, so every screen arrives like a show (rest frame unchanged).
Orbiting halo: whatever is picked (the chosen card, tile, district or rank) gets a bright spark that runs round and round its border.
Liquid meters: every meter fills with moving candy stripes and a bright cap at its edge; dials get a ring of tick marks; the lean slider knob glows.
Icon medallions: each panel header's icon sits in a round gold-rimmed medallion with a soft glow, like a badge.
Holographic foil: the most important cards (gold panels, your Goal, Family squads, the picked tile) get a slow holographic foil sweep across them.
Nova damask: panels get a faint woven pattern of Team Nova N marks and little gold diamonds, like the lining of a Boss's coat.
Focal spotlight: a breathing pool of light sits behind the crew, the one thing the eye should land on first.
Light show: a neon glow breathes around the edge of the screen, and two searchlights in the screen's colours sweep the night sky behind everything.
Gold-leaf lettering: title-tab lettering gets a bevel (light top edge, deep shadow), headers on gold panels turn to gold leaf, and ribbons and banners get engraved edges.
Ornate frame: the whole screen gets a fine double gold frame with filigree corners and gem studs, so every screen reads as a framed Dominion page.
Depth and underglow: panels float higher: a deeper soft shadow plus an underglow in the screen's key colour, so the UI layer separates cleanly from the scene behind it.
Hardware details: tabs get brass screw heads, pills and chips get a glossy top, paper notes get a stitched inner seam, and key caps get a shiny bevel.

Readability and naming check: checked that every line still reads clearly over the new effects (the haze, grade and edge glow stay behind or below text); the Rotom chip says “Quick” instead of a model name.
Living backdrop: the background never sits still: painted scenes slowly drift and zoom like a camera pan, and checkered floors slide gently.
Finale burst: a slow-turning sunburst crowns the crew and two star glints flash beside it: the screen's signature moment.
